zh: 参考入口：从夜之庭园东北侧向上，再向西到瞭望塔。
羽毛泡泡提供临时飞行。塔内三次飞行时长升级集中在中央帐篷左上、远侧左上及右上；先检查这些方向，再继续登顶。
塔顶为星歌者遭遇，战后检查相邻房间的金色羽毛。
en: Reference approach: climb out of northeastern Night Garden, then head west to the tower.
Feather bubbles grant temporary flight. Three duration upgrades lie above-left of the central tent, farther northwest and in the upper-right section; check those routes before ascending.
Starsinger awaits at the top. Check the adjacent room for a Golden Feather afterwards.

zh: 以中央帐篷作为回访基点；飞行时长升级和金色羽毛是不同项目。
en: Use the central tent as a return point. Flight-duration upgrades and Golden Feathers are separate items.

zh: 西侧入口的参考路线涉及两处拉杆，其中一处需回访猎人小屋上方。
森林深处为森林之王遭遇；战后继续向右查看金色羽毛。
同一羽毛房间内，Ilda 右侧隐藏通道有故事书页；先确认攀爬路线。
en: The western approach uses two levers, including one above Hunter's Cabin.
The Forest King encounter lies deeper in the forest; check to the right afterwards for a Golden Feather.
A story page is hidden right of Ilda in the feather room; check the climbing route.

zh: 区域位于地图上方，呈橙色；森林之王场地是主要推进地标。
en: The orange region sits near the top of the map; the Forest King arena is a main landmark.

zh: 机关规则：同一轮让石球碰到全部石柱；落地、撞墙或离开画面会重置。
第一处：向左或右击球，让它在两根石柱间反弹。
第二处：先向右击球，登上右侧平台后把球打向左墙石柱；等球返回时向上击中顶柱。
第三处：先向左击球，借中央蘑菇跳起，把下落的球打向右侧弹性物的左上部。
第四处：先向左击球，及时登上高台再次向左打，再到左侧顶端蘑菇旁接球送入石柱。
玩偶头支路：向左击球后尽快攀爬到房间上部，球经过石柱下方时向上击打。
en: Hit every pillar in one attempt; floor, wall or off-screen contact resets the orb.
First: send the orb sideways between both pillars.
Second: hit right, climb right, redirect left, then strike upward on its return.
Third: hit left, bounce on the middle mushroom and redirect toward the upper-left of the right bumper.
Fourth: hit left, climb and redirect left again; intercept beside the upper-left mushroom.
Doll’s Head branch: hit left, climb quickly and strike upward beneath the pillar.

zh: 一条推荐路线从沼泽西端使用无限攀爬进入本区。
向房屋下层推进，完成玩偶师遭遇后检查西侧的 Magda 与墙壁弹射能力。
本区故事书页包含需要悬停、攀爬或弹射的回访位置。
en: One recommended approach enters from western Bog using Endless Climb.
Progress into the lower house; after the Dollmaker encounter, check west for Magda and Wall Sling.
Some story-page routes need Hover, Climb or Slingshot on a return visit.

zh: 从下层遭遇位置向西衔接新能力。
en: The new-ability route continues west of the lower encounter.

zh: 参考路线使用墙壁弹射，从午夜雨境进入墓室。
向西推进至掘墓者；战后向左护送蜗牛到聚会处，继续领取金色羽毛。
en: The reference route enters from Midnight Drench using Wall Sling.
Continue west to Gravedigger, then escort the snail left to the party and Golden Feather.

zh: 掘墓者与聚会方向位于本区西侧。
en: The boss and party route are on the western side.

zh: 七子神龛位于本区。胜利后向左检查金色羽毛。
从旅店追逐成功逃出后会回到午夜雨境。
en: Shrine of the Seven Sons is here; check left after victory for a Golden Feather.
Escaping the Innkeeper returns you to Midnight Drench.

zh: 地图上的深蓝色区域；可用七子神龛场地定位金色羽毛路线。
en: The dark-blue region; use the Shrine arena to orient the feather route.

zh: 追逐主要向左推进。依次处理可破坏障碍、落地砸开的地板和需要敲钟切换的平台。
留意蛛网球的借力点；按画面中的交互提示操作。
最后长距离滑出后回到午夜雨境，并取得金色羽毛。
en: The chase runs mainly left. Handle breakable barriers, smashable floors and bell-switched platforms.
Watch for web-ball launch points and follow the on-screen interaction prompt.
The final long slide exits into Midnight Drench and awards a Golden Feather.

zh: 紫色区域；底部通道与向左追逐出口是主要地标。
en: A purple region; the lower passage and leftward chase exit are key landmarks.

zh: 集齐七根金色羽毛后，从沼泽进入城堡。
寻找 Ilda 的三对兄弟姐妹；其中一对由银色玩偶守护。
完成女王战后仍可回访补收集。
en: With seven Golden Feathers, enter the castle from the Bog.
Find Ilda's three sibling pairs; Silver Doll guards one pair.
Exploration and collection remain available after the Queen fight.

zh: 皇家紫色区域；先按兄弟姐妹任务推进到女王。
en: The royal-purple region; follow the sibling objective towards the Queen.

zh: 黑羽圈出现时用滑行穿过空隙；处理弹幕时仍要留意砸地起手。
后半段攻击更密集，保持移动，并在安全间隙使用火焰容器。
en: Slide through gaps in feather rings and watch for ground slams while reading projectiles.
Later patterns intensify; keep moving and use Flaming Vessels in safe openings.

zh: lookout-tower
en: lookout-tower

zh: 场地狭窄，主要危险来自环境；向上叶片出现时利用侧墙与悬停。
落石产生尖刺时，可借石块避开地面。战后继续向右检查羽毛。
en: In the narrow arena, use side walls and Hover against rising leaves.
Use fallen rocks to avoid floor spikes, then check right for the feather after the fight.

zh: autumn-forest
en: autumn-forest

zh: 中央光束与地面电流可结合侧墙攀爬、悬停处理。
弹跳电球会追踪位置；粉色光柱预告地面骨臂，尽早离开预告位置。
en: Combine side-wall climbing and Hover against central beams and floor electricity.
Keep moving from tracking electric balls; leave pink warning columns before bone arms emerge.

zh: midnight-drench
en: midnight-drench

zh: 砸铲后的地面骨刺持续较久，优先悬停避开。
骨球会飞出再返回，第一次避开后仍要留回旋空间。
en: Hover over persistent floor spikes after shovel slams.
Bone balls return after travelling outward; leave space to evade the return path.

zh: burial-vault
en: burial-vault

zh: 多镜下落时找眼睛朝上的镜子，移动到其下方安全区。
分身阶段同时控制两侧角色，先关注攻击所在半屏，再处理另一侧弹幕。
en: During falling mirrors, shelter beneath the mirror with the upward-looking eye.
When split into mirrored characters, prioritise the attacked half before handling the other side's projectiles.

zh: dollmakers-house
en: dollmakers-house

zh: 共 23 页，分为《女巫的交易》9 页、《玩偶师》8 页、《瞭望塔》6 页。
菜单 Pages 分页可核对分组；女王战后可以继续补齐。
en: 23 pages form three books: The Witch's Bargain (9), The Dollmaker (8) and The Lookout Tower (6).
Check the Pages menu by book; collection remains possible after the Queen fight.

zh: 攻击鸟形雕像释放灵魂，带回夜之庭园的灵魂标记处。
地图标记分别显示发现与归还数量；完成 20 次归还对应 Full Flock。
en: Strike bird statues to release spirits and return them at the Night Garden spirit marker.
The marker distinguishes found and returned counts; 20 returns complete Full Flock.

zh: 与 Whisper 对话取得金钥匙后检查金门：腿在墓谷、手臂在干涸城堡、躯干在排水道、头在沼泽。
四部分集齐后返回任务位置，修复 Looter 并领取金色羽毛。
en: After Whisper gives the key, check Golden Gates: legs in Graven Valley, arms in Desiccated Castle, torso in the Drains and head in the Bog.
Return all four parts to repair Looter and receive a Golden Feather.

zh: 先取得风乘。三处部件位于排水道右上、左下及中央帐篷上方的风道路线。
集齐后回中央帐篷旁电梯，操作拉杆继续推进。
en: Get Wind Ride first. Search the upper-right, lower-left and wind-tunnel route above the central tent.
Return all three parts to the elevator beside the central tent and use its lever.

zh: 通关后的五个碎片区域：玩偶师之家、夜之庭园、秋日森林、码头、干涸城堡。
取得 Soar 与神秘地图后，留意目标下方朝上的灵魂鸟提示。
码头碎片需要下落挑战收集 100 个闪光物；失败可依屏幕提示重试。
en: Five postgame fragment regions: Dollmaker's House, Night Garden, Autumn Forest, the Docks and Desiccated Castle.
With Soar and the mysterious map, look below targets for upward-pointing spirit birds.
The Docks fragment requires 100 pickups in a falling challenge; retry using the displayed prompt.

zh: 金色羽毛共七根，用于开放女王城堡入口。
瞭望塔的三次飞行时长升级不是金色羽毛。
en: Seven Golden Feathers open the Queen's Castle entrance.
The tower's three flight-duration upgrades are separate items.

en: looter-parts

zh: 取得风乘，寻找排水道三处部件，再回中央帐篷旁电梯。
en: Acquire Wind Ride, find the three Drains parts and return to the central-tent elevator.

zh: elevator-parts
en: elevator-parts

zh: 击败掘墓者后向左护送蜗牛，抵达聚会并检查金色羽毛奖励。
en: After Gravedigger, escort the snail left to the party and check the Golden Feather reward.

zh: burial-vault
en: burial-vault

zh: 收齐七根金色羽毛后，回沼泽的城堡入口。
en: Return to the Bog castle entrance with all seven Golden Feathers.

zh: queens-castle
en: queens-castle

zh: 取得处刑门票后进入遭遇。追踪刀刃出现时留意滑行冷却。
后半段场地收窄，观察三把下落刀刃之间的空隙；战后左侧寻找 Egbert。
en: Enter after obtaining the execution ticket; track homing blades and your slide cooldown.
As the arena narrows, use gaps between falling cleavers. Find Egbert to the left afterwards.

zh: graven-valley
en: graven-valley

zh: 位于码头，需在使用水下载具前处理。
留意横向冲刺与地面冲击波；用悬停避开地面危险，落地前检查下一轮攻击。
en: The encounter is in the Docks, before Water Vessel access.
Watch lateral charges and floor shockwaves; Hover above ground hazards and read the next attack before landing.

zh: the-docks
en: the-docks

zh: 驾驶水下载具从码头进入深渊。前段需同时注意弹幕与地面冲击波。
后半段变形后出现追踪尖刺，保持移动。胜利后查看 Thistle 与 Thimble。
en: Reach the Depths by Water Vessel from the Docks. Read both projectiles and floor shockwaves early.
The later form adds tracking spikes; keep moving. Check for Thistle and Thimble after victory.

zh: the-deep
en: the-deep

zh: 落地会带来尖刺或碎片，先避开落点。
滚轮从两侧向中央逼近时结合悬停、滑行或侧墙躲避；战后检查右侧兄弟姐妹。
en: Avoid landing points that produce spikes or shards.
Combine Hover, slides or a side wall against wheels converging from both sides; check right for the siblings afterwards.

zh: queens-castle
en: queens-castle

zh: 前段用悬停处理地刺，并为滑行冷却留出余量。
后半段地面变危险时转移到升起的平台，结合悬停和火柴借力躲避下落障碍。
en: Hover over early floor spikes and allow for the slide cooldown.
When the floor becomes hazardous, move to raised platforms; combine Hover and matchstick jumps against falling obstacles.

zh: queens-castle
en: queens-castle

zh: 虫群在上方时向上攻击；侧面虫墙出现时借泡泡越过。
出现头骨后可攻击头骨，但需额外躲避砸地产生的冲击波。
en: Attack upward when the swarm is overhead; use bubbles to clear insect walls.
Once the skull appears, attack it while avoiding its added ground-slam shockwave.

zh: the-bog
en: the-bog

zh: 三处电梯部件齐全后，从中央帐篷旁电梯进入。敌人在上方时向上攻击，先处理生成的小怪。
敌人消失、场地滚动时专注躲避下方尖球，留意滑行冷却。
en: Enter via the central-tent elevator with all three parts. Attack upward and clear summoned enemies first.
When the boss disappears and the arena scrolls, focus on lower spike balls and your slide cooldown.

zh: the-drains
en: the-drains

zh: 取得门票并完成利达遭遇后，检查左侧房间中的 Egbert。
en: After the ticket and Lida encounter, check the left-hand room for Egbert.

zh: graven-valley
en: graven-valley

zh: 深入深渊并击败群落后，查看获救的 Thistle 与 Thimble。
en: After the Colony in the Depths, check the rescued Thistle and Thimble.

zh: the-deep
en: the-deep

zh: 寻找三对被囚的兄弟姐妹；靠近所在房间后出现目标标记。
银色玩偶右侧有一对。全数解救后按地图提示返回，继续前往女王。
en: Find three captive sibling pairs; markers appear when you approach their rooms.
One pair is right of Silver Doll. After all rescues, follow the map's return objective towards the Queen.

zh: queens-castle
en: queens-castle

zh: 女王城堡内共有三对；解救后按目标提示回到 Ilda，衔接女王路线。
en: Three pairs in Queen's Castle; after rescue, follow the objective back to Ilda for the Queen route.

zh: 取得 Soar 后，从能力巢穴沿长竖井上行寻找神秘地图，可显示五处碎片目标。
en: With Soar, ascend the long shaft above its nest to the mysterious map and its five fragment targets.

zh: 资料清单记录 27 枚。工坊代币配合货币，用于帐篷工坊升级可升级饰物。
图标为带锤子的铜色五边形；先核对饰物是否已达到最高等级。
en: The reference checklist records 27 tokens. Spend tokens and currency at the tent workshop on upgradeable trinkets.
Look for bronze pentagons with a hammer; check each trinket's upgrade level.

zh: 按用途查找钥匙、部件、金色羽毛和剧情标记；下方目录可进入各物品页。
en: Browse keys, parts, Golden Feathers and story markers by purpose; open each item from the directory below.

zh: 按任务用途检查物品：电梯维修、Looter 修复，以及城堡救援。
en: Check items by objective: elevator repair, Looter restoration and castle rescues.

zh: elevator-parts
looter-parts
ildas-siblings
en: elevator-parts
looter-parts
ildas-siblings

zh: 秋日森林的木车商贩出售节庆帽，资料价格为 10 货币；购买对应 The King's Cap 成就。
商贩位于球与立柱谜题之后的一间房。
en: A cart merchant in Autumn Forest sells a festive hat for 10 currency in the reference guide; buying it completes The King's Cap.
Look in the room following an orb-and-pillar puzzle.

zh: autumn-forest
en: autumn-forest

zh: 能力：弹射、攀爬。奖励：饰物槽。
en: Slingshot and Climb. Reward: trinket slot.

zh: 能力：攀爬。向上竞速，奖励：饰物槽。
en: Climb; race upward. Reward: trinket slot.

zh: 能力：攀爬、悬停。奖励：灵魂。
en: Climb and Hover. Reward: spirit.

zh: 能力：攀爬、悬停、弹射。奖励：灵魂。
en: Climb, Hover and Slingshot. Reward: spirit.

zh: 能力：悬停、攀爬。避开旋转尖刺与下落平台，奖励：灵魂。
en: Hover and Climb; dodge rotating spikes on falling platforms. Reward: spirit.

zh: 挑战内无需额外能力，以快速下落为主。奖励：饰物槽。
en: No extra ability within the trial; descend quickly. Reward: trinket slot.

zh: 挑战内无需额外能力，使用跑跳与滑行。奖励：灵魂。
en: Run, jump and slide without extra abilities. Reward: spirit.

zh: 借泡泡快速移动，挑战内无需额外能力。奖励：工坊代币。
en: Use bubbles; no extra ability within the trial. Reward: workshop token.

zh: 挑战使用弹射，奖励路线另需无限攀爬。奖励：饰物槽。
en: Slingshot for the trial; Endless Climb afterwards. Reward: trinket slot.

zh: 能力：无限攀爬、悬停。奖励：鱼钩饰物。
en: Endless Climb and Hover. Reward: Fish Hook trinket.

zh: 门石共三块。以帐篷为起点，先向右进入上方支路找第一块。
返回下层并继续向右到底，检查第二块；随后再下行，经右侧路线向上找第三块。
集齐后按地图新增的目标标记返回大门；门石不是金色羽毛。
en: Three Gate Stones are needed. From the tent, head right and up for the first.
Descend and go far right for the second; then descend again and climb through the right-hand route for the third.
After collecting all three, follow the new gate objective marker; these are not Golden Feathers.

zh: 饰物来自地图探索与 Looter 商店，共 32 件；装备前核对效果与占用槽数。
探索时可考虑玻璃眼，便于发现隐藏通道；风化硬币能提高敌人掉落的货币。
en: There are 32 trinkets from exploration and Looter’s shop; check effects and slot costs before equipping.
Glass Eye helps reveal hidden passages; Weathered Coin increases enemy currency drops.

zh: 饰物槽用于扩展装备容量，不等于饰物数量。地图、灵魂归还奖励和商店都能提供槽位。
商店可重复购买许多槽位，不宜把攻略列出的收集编号当作容量上限。
en: Slots increase equipment capacity rather than trinket count. They come from exploration, spirit-return rewards and the shop.
The shop sells many slots; a walkthrough’s numbered pickups do not establish a capacity limit.

zh: 先在 Looter 商店购买并装备瓶盖饰物，再找帐篷附近的平坦空间练习。
向上抛瓶，保持在瓶子下方，用火柴连续向上击打十次；失败后回帐篷补充再试。
en: Buy and equip Bottle Cap, then practise on flat ground near a tent.
Throw upward and stay underneath, hitting upward ten times; refill at the tent between attempts.

zh: 发生在干涸城堡的女王搜寻段落。避开探照光束，利用房间遮挡分段移动。
被发现会回到检查点；通过整段并触发 Looter 被抓的剧情后解锁。
en: This occurs during the Queen’s search in Desiccated Castle. Avoid the searchlight and move between cover.
Detection returns you to a checkpoint; finish the sequence and Looter’s capture scene to unlock it.

zh: 目标为收齐 32 件饰物，商店出售的饰物也计入。
收尾时检查旅店的虫翅与余烬瓶，以及归还灵魂获得的饰物。
en: Collect all 32 trinkets, including those sold in the shop.
For cleanup, check Insect Wing and Ember Vial in the inn, plus spirit-return trinket rewards.

zh: 条件是把所有可升级饰物升到最高级，不是单纯收齐工坊代币。
逐件检查工坊菜单，预留货币和代币；没有升级选项的饰物无需额外处理。
en: Max out every upgradeable trinket; collecting Workshop Tokens alone is insufficient.
Check each workshop entry and reserve currency and tokens; trinkets without upgrades need no further work.

zh: 先击败女王，取得腾空能力与神秘地图，再完成五个灵魂碎片目标。
同时确认 20 个灵魂已经归还，最后回夜之庭园的灵魂归还处触发团聚。
en: Defeat the Queen, obtain Soar and the mysterious map, then collect all five Spirit Fragments.
Also return all 20 spirits, then revisit the Night Garden spirit-return point for the reunion.

zh: 通关后检查女王硬币。社区流程在第十集开头记录获取，并说明可降低工坊价格。
尚未完成饰物升级时，先核对当前菜单价格再安排收尾购买。
en: Check for the Queen’s Coin after the main ending. Episode 10 records it near the start and notes reduced workshop prices.
